title: houstonia nigricans var. angulata
intro: Houstonia nigricans var. angulata, commonly known as the angle-leaved twinflower, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Houstonia nigricans var. angulata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
